---
title: "Fudgy Brownies"
---

## Ingredients

1 + 1/2 cup sugar

3/4 cup a.p. flour

3/4 cup cooking oil

1/2 cup cocoa powder

1 + 1/2 tsp vanilla essence

3 eggs

1/4 + 1/8 tsp baking powder

1/4 tsp salt

## Directions

Mix sugar, oil, vanilla and eggs in a bowl.

In a separate bowl mix cocoa powder, baking powder, salt and flour.

Add dry ingredients to wet and mix together.

Pour into a greased/lined pan.

Bake for 25-30 mins in a 180°C/350°F preheated oven.
